title: Open task in Wework
description: Choose the button below to open Wework at this task.
browser_hint: If Wework did not open, make sure the matching app is installed. You can also open this page in your system browser and try again, or view the task on the web.
dingtalk_title: Open this page in a browser
dingtalk_description: DingTalk's built-in browser does not hand this page to Wework. Tap the top-right menu, then choose Open in browser to launch Wework directly.
dingtalk_hint: Choose Safari on iPhone or Chrome on Android.
invalid_description: This link does not identify a task. Return to the notification and open it again.
